C1_RELATION_KEY = "R606_named_same_measurement_original_summaries"


def share_original_C1_summaries(summary):
    """Only two named, equal, complete same-measurement summary relations."""
    if C1_RELATION_KEY in summary:
        return summary
    raw = canonical(summary); answer = copy.deepcopy(summary)
    series = answer.get("schema") == SERIES_SCHEMA
    rows = answer.get("levels") if series else [answer]
    if not isinstance(rows,list):
        return summary
    references = []
    for index,row in enumerate(rows):
        if not isinstance(row,dict):
            continue
        owner = row.get("actual_continuous_RHS_C1_defect")
        target = owner.get("original_R601_summary") if isinstance(owner,dict) else None
        if not isinstance(target,dict):
            continue
        for name,(outer,inner) in C1_SUMMARY_RELATIONS.items():
            frame = row.get(outer)
            source = frame.get(inner) if isinstance(frame,dict) else None
            key = "actual_"+name+"_summary"
            if (not isinstance(source,dict) or key not in target
                    or not isinstance(target[key],dict)
                    or canonical(source) != canonical(target[key])):
                continue
            references.append(dict(container_index=index,original=name,
                complete_summary_identity=value_identity(source)))
            target[key] = {"R606_same_measurement_summary":name}
    if not references:
        return summary
    answer[C1_RELATION_KEY] = dict(schema="R606-complete-original-summary-relations-v1",
        container_kind="series_levels" if series else "one_measurement",
        named_relations={key:list(value) for key,value in C1_SUMMARY_RELATIONS.items()},
        destination=["actual_continuous_RHS_C1_defect","original_R601_summary"],
        references=references,complete_unshared_selected_identity=dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=sha(raw)),
        original_result_file_unchanged=True,complete_source_remains_literal_in_same_row=True,
        missing_null_types_signed_zero_order_and_unknown_fields_preserved=True,
        inverse="expand_original_C1_summaries")
    return answer if len(canonical(answer)) < len(raw) else summary


def expand_original_C1_summaries(summary):
    """Exact named metadata inverse; never a science or writer-test gate."""
    answer = copy.deepcopy(summary)
    if C1_RELATION_KEY not in answer:
        return answer
    table = answer.pop(C1_RELATION_KEY)
    require(isinstance(table,dict) and table.get("schema") ==
        "R606-complete-original-summary-relations-v1"
        and table.get("named_relations") ==
            {key:list(value) for key,value in C1_SUMMARY_RELATIONS.items()}
        and table.get("destination") == ["actual_continuous_RHS_C1_defect","original_R601_summary"],
        "Expand only the two declared complete same-measurement originals")
    kind = table["container_kind"]
    require(kind in ("one_measurement","series_levels"),"Keep the original container kind")
    rows = [answer] if kind == "one_measurement" else answer["levels"]
    seen = set()
    for reference in table["references"]:
        index,name = reference["container_index"],reference["original"]
        require(type(index) is int and 0 <= index < len(rows)
            and name in C1_SUMMARY_RELATIONS and (index,name) not in seen,
            "Each declared original occurs once in its actual measurement")
        seen.add((index,name))
        outer,inner = C1_SUMMARY_RELATIONS[name]
        source = rows[index][outer][inner]
        target = rows[index]["actual_continuous_RHS_C1_defect"]["original_R601_summary"]
        key = "actual_"+name+"_summary"
        require(isinstance(source,dict)
            and value_identity(source) == reference["complete_summary_identity"]
            and target[key] == {"R606_same_measurement_summary":name},
            "Restore the exact complete original, not an inferred or null value")
        target[key] = copy.deepcopy(source)
    require(value_identity(answer) == table["complete_unshared_selected_identity"],
        "The entire original selected body must be recovered")
    return answer
